sql: SELECT "Invoice_Line_Items"."invoice_number" AS e, "Customers"."gender" AS g, AVG((CAST(("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_total_cost" - "Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_product_cost") AS REAL) / "Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_product_cost")) AS m1 FROM "Invoice_Line_Items" JOIN "Invoices" ON "Invoices"."invoice_number" = "Invoice_Line_Items"."invoice_number" JOIN "Orders" ON "Orders"."order_id" = "Invoices"."order_id" JOIN "Customers" ON "Customers"."customer_id" = "Orders"."customer_id" GROUP BY "Invoice_Line_Items"."invoice_number", "Customers"."gender" ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Invoice_Line_Items.relative difference of line total cost including VAT from line product cost
why: (line total cost including VAT - line product cost) / line product cost: the relative difference of two quantities in USD
average of relative difference of line total cost including VAT from line product cost per Invoices within Customers.gender

sql: SELECT "Invoice_Line_Items"."order_item_id" AS e, "Customers"."gender" AS g, AVG((CAST(("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_product_cost" - "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_price") AS REAL) / "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_price")) AS m1 FROM "Invoice_Line_Items" JOIN "Order_Items" ON "Order_Items"."order_item_id" = "Invoice_Line_Items"."order_item_id" JOIN "Orders" ON "Orders"."order_id" = "Order_Items"."order_id" JOIN "Customers" ON "Customers"."customer_id" = "Orders"."customer_id" GROUP BY "Invoice_Line_Items"."order_item_id", "Customers"."gender" ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Invoice_Line_Items.relative difference of line product cost from product price per unit
why: (line product cost - product price per unit) / product price per unit: the relative difference of two quantities in USD
average of relative difference of line product cost from product price per unit per Order_Items within Customers.gender

sql: SELECT "Products"."product_color" AS g, AVG("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_total_cost") AS m1, AVG(("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_product_cost" - "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_price")) AS m2, (AVG("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_total_cost") - AVG(("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_product_cost" - "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_price"))) AS m3 FROM "Invoice_Line_Items" JOIN "Products" ON "Products"."product_id" = "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id" GROUP BY "Products"."product_color"
quantities: Invoice_Line_Items.line product cost minus product price per unit
why: average of line total cost including VAT per Products.product_color
line product cost - product price per unit: both in USD and of the same kind (same additivity) on the same one product line on an invoice
average of line product cost minus product price per unit per Products.product_color

sql: SELECT "Invoice_Line_Items"."order_item_id" AS e, "Customers"."state_county_province" AS g, AVG((CAST(("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_total_cost" - "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_price") AS REAL) / "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_price")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "Invoice_Line_Items" JOIN "Order_Items" ON "Order_Items"."order_item_id" = "Invoice_Line_Items"."order_item_id" JOIN "Orders" ON "Orders"."order_id" = "Order_Items"."order_id" JOIN "Customers" ON "Customers"."customer_id" = "Orders"."customer_id" GROUP BY "Invoice_Line_Items"."order_item_id", "Customers"."state_county_province" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10

sql: SELECT "Invoice_Line_Items"."order_item_id" AS e, "Product_Categories"."product_type_description" AS g, AVG((CAST(("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_product_cost" - "Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_total_cost") AS REAL) / "Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_total_cost")) AS m1 FROM "Invoice_Line_Items" JOIN "Order_Items" ON "Order_Items"."order_item_id" = "Invoice_Line_Items"."order_item_id" JOIN "Products" ON "Products"."product_id" = "Order_Items"."product_id" JOIN "Product_Categories" ON "Product_Categories"."production_type_code" = "Products"."production_type_code" GROUP BY "Invoice_Line_Items"."order_item_id", "Product_Categories"."product_type_description" ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10

why: (line product cost - line total cost including VAT) / line total cost including VAT: the relative difference of two quantities in USD
average of relative difference of line product cost from line total cost including VAT per Order_Items within Product_Categories.product_type_description
